# deCONZ server scenarios, run by the Rust test and by a one-off harness over the C++
# DeconzServer + ZigbeeCoordinator (rust-port-base) with a stub link; deconz.txt is its output.
#   new                 fresh link, coordinator, server (default slots), coordinator started
#   client              a (new) client connects
#   req CMD HEX         client frame: command CMD, next sequence number, payload HEX ("-" = none)
#   raw HEX             client bytes as they are
#   radio TYPE HEX      frame from the radio
#   ack STATUS          the radio's next ACK carries this status
# Network states (0x8A00): formed = PAN 1A62, channel 15, ext DD.., IEEE 00124B0001020304,
# NWK 0000, update id 3, key 07.., key seq 0, frame counter 5000.
